scope: Public primary-source research and project advice; no application code or model configuration changed
findings: Formula-to-LaTeX is a mature documented route in Azure Document Intelligence, Docling, PaddleOCR and Mathpix; documentation is evidence of implementation, not a market-share survey.
Structured parsing and visual document retrieval are distinct approaches; ColPali documents image-based retrieval.
Recommendation: preserve formula source and original location, keep formula blocks intact, include surrounding definitions in retrieval, render on the frontend, and review uncertain recognition.
DeepSeek-OCR officially distinguishes document-to-Markdown and generic OCR prompts; project changes require comparative tests, not an assumed improvement.
